Using \(O<4\cdot180^\circ=720^\circ\) and \(A\le (n-4)90^\circ\),
\[
(n-2)180 = O+A < 720 + (n-4)90.
\]
So
\[
180n-360 < 720+90n-360 \implies 90n<720 \implies n<8.
\]
Thus \(n\le 7\). This is attainable: for \(n=7\), angles
\[
165^\circ,165^\circ,165^\circ,165^\circ,80^\circ,80^\circ,80^\circ
\]
sum to \(900^\circ=(7-2)180^\circ\) and give exactly four obtuse angles.

\boxed{7}
